initialExam.title: Maharashtra Judicial Services 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Civil Judges (Junior Division) and Judicial Magistrate (First Class) in Maharashtra through competitive examination conducted by the Bombay High Court.
initialExam.eligibility: LLB from recognized university + enrolled advocate
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Civil Law (CPC, Indian Contract Act, Transfer of Property Act, Specific Relief Act, Limitation Act), Criminal Law (IPC, CrPC, Indian Evidence Act, NDPS Act, POCSO Act), Constitutional Law (Fundamental Rights, DPSP, Writs, Emergency), Maharashtra Local Acts (Maharashtra Rent Control Act, Maharashtra Land Revenue Code, MRTP Act), English & Marathi Language.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims (Objective): Civil + Criminal + Constitutional Law - 200 marks, 120 min. Mains: Paper I (Civil Law) 200 marks, Paper II (Criminal Law) 200 marks, Paper III (Language) 100 marks - 180 min each. Viva Voce: 100 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination (Objective) → Mains Examination (Descriptive) → Viva Voce (Interview) → Document Verification → Medical Examination

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, Official Residence, Conveyance Allowance, Book Allowance, Robe Allowance
initialExam.careerGrowth: Civil Judge JD → Civil Judge SD → District Judge → High Court Judge (through elevation).
initialExam.jobRole: Presiding over civil and criminal cases in district and subordinate courts of Maharashtra. Conducting trials, recording evidence, delivering judgments.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit bombayhighcourt.nic.in 2. Go to Recruitment section 3. Register 4. Fill application 5. Upload documents 6. Pay fee 7. Submit
